title: Perfect 10 Magazine Jun/Jul 2000 All Natural Faces of E Brooke Burke Hal Sparks
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue in nice shape. Glossy cover is bright with light corner and edge wear and minor scuffing at the spine edges. A previous dealer's small handwritten inventory sticker is on the barcode box. Spine intact. No mailing label. Interior not page-checked - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Perfect 10 Magazine, June/July 2000 issue. Cover price $6.99.

Norm Zada's "The Connoisseur's Magazine" - the all-natural title that made a point of no cosmetic surgery, printed on heavy glossy stock.

Cover lines:
- The Faces of E! - A.J. Benza, Brooke Burke, Carol Grow, Scott Lasky, Hal Sparks (last of a two-part series on the E! Entertainment personalities)
- Great Touring Motorcycles
- 15 Natural Models Inside
- What a Man's Sign May Tell You

Blue bedroom cover with the blonde cover model. The back cover is the embossed skyline-and-railing figure with PERFECT10.COM - no advertising - and the spine reads "June/July 2000".

Condition: pre-owned with light handling wear; see the photos and condition note. The cover in the listing photo has been masked for eBay's image rules; the magazine itself is unaltered.
